16: // Group manages goroutines and collect all the errors.
17: // See https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/sync/errgroup#group for more information
18: type Group interface {
19: 	WithContext(ctx context.Context) context.Context
20: 	WithPanicHandler(f func(any))
21: 	Wait() error
22: 	Go(name string, f func(logger *zap.Logger) error)
23: }

26: 	cancel       context.CancelFunc
27: 	logger       *zap.Logger
28: 	panicHandler func(any)
29: 
30: 	wg sync.WaitGroup
31: 
32: 	errMutex sync.Mutex
33: 	err      error
34: }
35: 
36: // NewGroup returns a new Group.
37: func NewGroup(logger *zap.Logger) Group {
38: 	return &group{
39: 		cancel:       nil, // Set separately by WithContext
40: 		panicHandler: nil, // Set separately by WithPanicHandler
41: 		logger:       logger,
42: 		wg:           sync.WaitGroup{},
43: 
44: 		errMutex: sync.Mutex{},
45: 		err:      nil,
46: 	}
47: }
48: 
49: // WithContext updates the current Group with a associated Context.
50: // The context will be canceled if any goroutine returns an error.
51: // See https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/sync/errgroup#WithContext
52: func (g *group) WithContext(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
53: 	ctx, g.cancel = context.WithCancel(ctx)
54: 	return ctx
55: }
56: 
57: // WithPanicHandler sets a panic handler for the group.
58: func (g *group) WithPanicHandler(f func(any)) {
59: 	g.panicHandler = f
60: }
61: 
62: // Wait blocks until all goroutines have completed.
63: //
64: // All errors returned from the goroutines will be combined into one using multierr and returned from this method.
65: func (g *group) Wait() error {
66: 	g.wg.Wait()
67: 	if g.cancel != nil {
68: 		g.cancel()
69: 	}
70: 	return g.err
71: }
72: 
73: func (g *group) call(f func() error) (err error) {
74: 	defer func() {
75: 		if r := recover(); r != nil {
76: 			if g.panicHandler != nil {
77: 				g.panicHandler(r)
78: 			}
79: 			err = fmt.Errorf("panic: %v", r)
80: 		}
81: 	}()
82: 	err = f()
83: 	return err
84: }
85: 
86: // Go calls the function in a new goroutine.
87: // If a non-nil errors is returned, the context is canceled and
88: // the error is collected using multierr and will be returned by Wait.
89: func (g *group) Go(name string, f func(logger *zap.Logger) error) {
90: 	g.wg.Add(1)
91: 
92: 	go func() {
93: 		defer g.wg.Done()
94: 		logger := g.logger.Named(name)
95: 		cb := func() error {
96: 			return f(logger)
97: 		}
98: 		if err := g.call(cb); err != nil {
99: 			err = fmt.Errorf("task %s failed: %w", name, err)
100: 			g.errMutex.Lock()
101: 			g.err = multierr.Append(g.err, err)
102: 			g.errMutex.Unlock()
103: 			logger.Error(err.Error())
104: 			if g.cancel != nil {
105: 				g.cancel()
106: 			}
107: 		}
108: 	}()
109: }
